summary: Ephemeral environment bootstrap failing: role ARN normalization & role-path mismatch between credential broker and AWS
description:
Issue summary:
Ephemeral environment bootstrap for experimental-llm-sandbox is failing during credential exchange. The credential broker attempts to construct an assume-role ARN with the role path URL-encoded, which does not match the canonical ARN expected by AWS STS when passing session tags from GCP WIF.

Impact:
- Oncalls and SREs cannot provision ephemeral sandboxes for ML debug jobs via the web onboarding flow.
- Several data-science jobs queued in staging are blocked; blocking developer productivity.
- Affects both staging-us-west and some prod-us-east onboarding requests routed through the new broker.

Environment:
- Credential broker: infra/credential-broker v0.9.3 (k8s deployment in staging-us-west)
- GCP WIF pool: projects/ops/pools/ephemeral-wif
- Affected AWS accounts: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops/ephemeral/debugger
- Terraform runner and web UI bootstrap paths both observed failing.

Expected behavior:
- Broker generates assume-role ARNs that exactly match AWS role resource names (no extraneous encoding) and STS AssumeRole succeeds with session tags preserved.

Actual behavior:
- STS AssumeRole call returns AccessDenied with message referencing a non-existent role ARN. The ARN in the broker log contains percent-encoding for the role path ("%2F"), while AWS expects plain "/" in the role resource path.

Notes on scope and novelty:
- This is not the classic session-tag truncation (see INT-860351) nor a WIF audience mismatch; the call reaches STS and is rejected due to name mismatch. The broker is building ARNs using url.PathEscape() semantics in Go, which is causing the mismatch.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Start web onboarding flow for ephemeral environment 'experimental-llm-sandbox' in staging-us-west.
2) Broker exchanges GCP WIF assertion for STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity to target role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops/ephemeral/debugger.
3) Observe broker logs: the generated 'RoleArn' field is 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role%2Fops%2Fephemeral%2Fdebugger'.
4) STS responds with AccessDenied / role does not exist error.
logs: 2026-03-11T09:14:02Z broker pod credential-broker-5f6c9: ERROR assume role failed: AccessDenied: The role with name 'role%2Fops%2Fephemeral%2Fdebugger' cannot be found\n\tat aws-sdk-go/service/sts.(*STS).AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
2026-03-11T09:14:03Z kube-apiserver: pod restarted credential-broker-5f6c9 (OOM not observed).
investigation_notes: 11-Mar 10:00 - Reproduced locally by invoking broker with a sample WIF token; observed same percent-encoded RoleArn. Hypothesis: broker uses url.PathEscape() instead of plain concatenation.
11-Mar 13:30 - Manual assume-role via AWS CLI using canonical ARN succeeds: aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops/ephemeral/debugger --role-session-name test -> SUCCESS.
11-Mar 15:05 - Confirmed terraform-runner and web UI both call same broker endpoint; failure surface is identical.
11-Mar 16:20 - Checked AWS account policy: no deny on tag keys; denies only trigger if role name mismatch, reinforcing ARN mismatch theory.

12-Mar 09:45 - Temporary workaround test: created a duplicate role with encoded name 'role%2Fops%2Fephemeral%2Fdebugger' (for testing only) and observed STS call succeed (proves encoding is the root cause).

Liam O'Connor (Assignee) 2026-03-11T11:05: 'Taking ownership. Reproduced locally. Suspect credential-broker string handling. Will add unit test and patch.'
Patel, SRE 2026-03-12T08:20: 'Checked cluster; no recent org-policy or IAM policy changes. Logging suggests code-level issue.'
Elena Rodriguez (Infra Eng) 2026-03-12T14:55: 'Created hotfix branch in infra/credential-broker; replacing url.PathEscape with explicit role path join. Running staging deployment smoke tests.'
workarounds: Create temporary alias role without path components (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ephemeral-debugger) and grant same trust policy to unblock teams.
Directly run AWS CLI assume-role with canonical role ARN for critical one-off debug sessions until broker fix is deployed.
next_steps: Merge and deploy PR to credential-broker that normalizes role ARNs without URL-encoding (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2187).
Add unit+integration test to catch encoded ARN regressions (exercise GCP WIF -> STS flow in CI).
Run a small canary rollout in staging-us-west then promote to prod-us-east; monitor for AccessDenied regressions in STS metrics.
After deployment, remove the temporary alias role and the test encoded role created during investigation.
Add an observability alert in console: high rate of STS AccessDenied errors with RoleArn containing '%25' or '%2F'.
resolution_notes: IN-PROGRESS: Hotfix branch created and PR opened (infra/credential-broker#2187). Staging canary passed basic smoke tests on 2026-03-12 15:20 UTC. Plan: deploy to staging rollout channel on 2026-03-13 18:00 UTC, monitor for 2 hours, then deploy to prod-us-east. Post-deploy cleanup tasks documented in linked Confluence page. Temporary alias role will be removed after confirmation.
followup_tasks: Audit credential-broker code for other uses of url.PathEscape that may impact IAM ARNs.
Add integration test in infra-ci that validates role ARN equality (unencoded) across multiple onboarding paths.
Document the expected canonical role naming convention for onboarding and include in runbook (confluence).
